Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 & -4 \\ -5 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1-10-3 & -1+2-1 & -4+0+2 \\ -1+15+0 & -1-3+0 & -4+0+0 \\ 0+15-15 & 0-3-5 & 0+0+10\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-14 & 0 & -2 \\ 14 & -4 & -4 \\ 0 & -8 & 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
